code.description: stream_unavailable is the 406 of a create-investigation request that asks for the event stream (Accept: text/event-stream) while the deployment has the stream turned off. It is written before any admission work and is not retryable. submission_mismatch, submission_in_progress, submission_unsaved and submission_abandoned are the 409s of a create-investigation request whose X-ACR-Submission-ID was already admitted: a different request under that id; its run still live (retryable, with Retry-After); answered but not stored; ended without an answer. None of them runs the request again. concurrency_limited and allowance_exhausted are the 429s of a create-investigation request that names a new X-ACR-Submission-ID over a shared Ask Dev limit: running runs per principal or per organization (details.limit principal or org), or the organization's monthly allowance of runs on the deployment's model. Both carry Retry-After; nothing was admitted.

details.description: Closed safe keys only. For a 400 invalid_request about the request body, details.reason is malformed_json, schema_violation, unknown_field, trailing_json or body_too_large, and details.field, when present, is the JSON path of the failing field. A budget_refusal is a 413 for a valid request whose answer did not fit the response budget; details carry the closed budget keys that route measured (overrun, measured_items, measured_bytes, max_items, max_serialized_bytes, retry_attempted, narrower_continuation); every key is optional and a route sends only the ones it measured.

limit.description: On a 429 rate_limited: which limit refused the request. request_budget is the organization's request budget; capabilities_budget is the capabilities handshake's own budget, spent by the caller-resolution call every MCP request makes; the credential was already decided in both cases. On a 429 concurrency_limited (CHAOS-11914): principal or org, the shared running-run limit that refused the submission. A consumer treats a value outside this enum as absent.

deadline.description: On a 504 upstream_unavailable: which deadline ended the investigation. model is one model attempt reaching its own timeout (ACR_CONTEXT_FABRIC_MODEL_TIMEOUT) before the request deadline; request is the request deadline (ACR_REQUEST_TIMEOUT or the caller's shorter wait budget). Absent when the answer cannot tell which. A consumer treats a value outside this enum as absent.
